label: 80 · Weighted Cards
description: Weights at both depths: a weights column SHARING the multi-select's key gives every card an auto-balancing share group over its own chips (two cells, one array — even sets round-trip as string[], customized as {id,weight}[]), and interWeightProp names a sibling number[] the strip drags to weigh the CARDS against each other. Render is the values wearing rectangles: row heights from mixWeights, chip widths from item shares.

connectionId.label: Connection
connectionId.description: The sibling wire (lesson 76): which configured connection profile the chip pickers read.

mixes.label: Mixes
mixes.description: Cards of chips with per-chip shares: a connectionMultiSelect column owns membership and a weights column SHARING ITS KEY owns shares — two cells, one array. Even sets round-trip as string[], customized ones as {id, weight}[].

mixWeights.label: Mix weights
mixWeights.description: How the mixes weigh against EACH OTHER — the sibling number[] the card strip's inter-card sliders write (interWeightProp).
